scoring_justification: Peak time and oscillation are recomputed from the raw RMS displacement CSV; variance ratios are cross-validated against the same CSV, so scoring does not trust self-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold for peak time of RMS displacement at electronic temperature 50 mhartree.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 1(a): peak at 146 fs for absorbed fluence 12 mJ/cm^2 (50 mhartree).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact value stated in paper text and figure.

outputs.description: Time series of root‑mean‑square atomic displacement; structural check verifies existence of oscillatory behaviour (a clear maximum followed by a decrease).
Reported squeezing metrics: peak time of RMS displacement and variance ratios relative to quantum zero‑point variance. Checker compares against paper‑reported values within generous tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The task focuses on the 50 mhartree electronic temperature case. Additional electronic temperatures may be computed optionally. The RMS displacement CSV must exhibit oscillatory behaviour; the peak and variance ratios must fall within experimentally motivated tolerances to account for code and stochastic differences.

steps.description: Recompute peak time of RMS displacement from CSV and compare to paper reported 146 fs (±40 fs).
Verify the time series shows a clear oscillation: maximum exceeds averages of first and last portions and decreases afterwards.
Cross-validate that reported variance ratios and zero-point variance are derived from the RMS displacement CSV.
